title: Suggested Workout is here
bullets: Suggested Workout picks exercises for you from your favorites, moves you haven't done in a while, and muscles that have recovered. Choose heavy, medium or light and how long you have.
Full screen is now one exercise at a time: big weight and reps, one tap for Set done, then rest, then your next set. The rest screen has a Next exercise button too.
26 workout plans for strength, muscle, fat loss, endurance, conditioning, bodyweight and mobility, with filters for level, days and equipment.
Swap a machine for a free-weight exercise (or the other way) that trains the same movement.
A cleaner look with one icon style across the app, a My Workouts button, and search in Preferences.
When you finish, you can use Aevyn's estimate instead of your watch's number.

screenshots.alt: Swapping a machine for a free-weight exercise

title: New Stats and a rest screen that counts you in
bullets: Stats has a fresh look: pick what to see and a time range, then check your Consistency radar and charts.
Rest between sets now fills the screen and counts you back in with 5-4-3-2-1 GO.
Exercise search understands muscles, nicknames, small typos and half-typed words.
Custom exercises can have calories per minute, with examples to help you pick a number.
Android: Aevyn can turn on Do Not Disturb while you work out.
Galaxy Watch calories are more accurate, using total calories and your heart rate.

title: Make your own exercises
bullets: Create your own exercises in Add Exercise, and edit or delete them any time.
Full-screen exercise mode shows one big card and nothing else.
Cardio calories use realistic rates for walking, running, rowing, bikes and more.
Forgot your password? Reset it with a code sent to your email.
Tap a task in Edit Routine to change its name or minutes.
